title: Portal of the Void Witch
description: A surreal painting shows a large stained-glass style window floating in a starry sky, containing a swirling purple vortex with a black central eye. Below it, a cloaked figure with long white hair stands in a lush garden beside a circular pool that mirrors the same swirling vortex, surrounded by vibrant flowers, ferns, and poppies under a dramatic red and blue twilight sky.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large cracked stained-glass window floating in a dramatic red and blue twilight sky with stars, inside it a swirling purple vortex with a black central eye. In the foreground, a cloaked female figure with long flowing white hair stands with her back to the viewer beside a circular pool reflecting the same vortex. The garden is filled with red and pink poppies, blue ferns, purple flowers, and dark mountains in the background.
